subject: Offer approval: Senior Runtime Engineer (Eden Rivera) — comp path & leveling
messages:
From: Sarah TierOne <sarah@tierone-recruit.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate accepted verbal — comp guidance needed

Hi Mina,

Good news — Eden Rivera (ex-Nimbus AI) verbally accepted and is excited about the role. They asked for formal offer and start-date flexibility (late July). Before I send the draft, can the comp team confirm the range and whether we can approve a leveling exception?

Quick facts:
- Role: Senior Runtime Engineer (IC4/IC5 ambiguity)
- Candidate target: $210k base + 15% target bonus + 0.15% equity
- Current internal band: IC4 range $170k–195k, IC5 $200k–235k (see attached lookup)

Can we greenlight $210k base at IC5 leveling with the proposed equity? If not, what approval route do you want me to follow?

Thanks,
Sarah
TierOne Recruiting
(she/her)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate accepted verbal — comp guidance needed

Lauren / Marissa — looping you in for comp & leveling signoff.

Short answer: I support making an exception to offer IC5-level comp for Eden given the ML systems background and scarcity on runtime infra. But we need formal signoff from People Ops for the band exception and VP approval for any equity above 0.12%.

Requests:
- Marissa, can you confirm whether $210k base + 15% bonus fits under our comp funding for IC5 at this headcount?
- Lauren, recommend we document leveling rationale (candidate impact, interview debrief notes) and seek VP approval. I can draft the one-paragraph justification.

Attachments: Eden resume, comp_band_lookup_ENG.xlsx (sarah attached).

Mina Haddad
Sr. Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate accepted verbal — comp guidance needed

Mina / Lauren,

Checked the band funding: we have headroom for a single IC5 at this level in Q3 as long as total comp (base + target bonus) stays <= $241k OTE. $210k + 15% bonus = $241.5k OTE — tiny bit over. Two options: reduce bonus to 14.5% or approve a minor comp exception (we've done these for strategic hires).

Equity: 0.15% would require VP signoff (equity committee threshold 0.12%). If you want to keep the candidate at $210k base and 15% bonus, I can route the paperwork for a one-off exception. Otherwise recommend 14.5% bonus to stay within funding and speed things up.

I'll prepare both numbers in the offer doc and flag the request path.

Marissa
Comp & People Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate accepted verbal — comp guidance needed

Thanks team.

Mina, please draft the leveling justification (2–3 bullet points) emphasizing: candidate led production runtime at Nimbus, improved latency by 30% on inference pipelines, and authored custom KV cache improvements we discussed in interview.

Marissa — please prepare the exception packet for VP review if needed. Karthik, please weigh in on budget impact and whether we prefer faster close (slightly reduced bonus) vs. stronger package (full 15% + equity exception). This hire is time sensitive; Eden has another verbal offer that could convert this week.

I prefer the shorter approval path: reduce bonus to 14.5% to stay within funding unless VP thinks equity is strategically necessary. If VP signs equity, keep bonus at 15%.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Talent Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate accepted verbal — comp guidance needed

Drafting the justification now — sending to VP for one-paragraph approval after Marissa prepares the packet.

Proposed offer (fast path):
- Base: $210,000
- Bonus: 14.5% (pro-rated first year)
- Equity: 0.12% (standard IC5 grant)
- Start window: July 26–Aug 9 (flexible)

If VP approves equity exception to 0.15%, we will keep bonus at 15% and expedite.

I will also send a short note to Eden to confirm they are happy to receive the doc tomorrow pending signoff.

Best,
Mina

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: VP People <vp_people@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval request: Equity exception for Eden Rivera (Senior Runtime) — quick review requested

Hi — forwarding a short packet for approval.

Candidate: Eden Rivera (ex-Nimbus AI)
Role: Senior Runtime Engineer (IC5)
Proposed comp scenarios:
1) Fast path (no VP equity exception): $210k base / 14.5% bonus / 0.12% equity — ready to send today.
2) Strong offer (needs VP equity exception): $210k base / 15% bonus / 0.15% equity — candidate prefers this.

Justification (key points from interview debrief):
- Led production inference runtime at Nimbus with measurable latency improvements (≈30%).
- Deep systems + ML infra experience aligned with our runtime roadmap (cache + kernel selection).
- High urgency — candidate has other offers and prefers an accelerated close.

Recommendation: Approve the equity exception to 0.15% if the VP judges this hire strategic. Otherwise sign off on the fast path to avoid losing candidate.

Attachments: resume, offer draft, comp band lookup.

Thanks for a quick read — please reply with Approve / Deny / Prefer fast path.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Talent Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
